## Maintainer eligibility

OpenState accepts pull requests from approved maintainers only. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Michael-A-Kuykendall/openstate/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md); unsolicited pull requests are declined. Everyone can report bugs and discuss ideas.

- [ ] I am an approved maintainer.
- [ ] My commits include the required DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`).

## Problem and change

Link the issue or agreed scope. Explain the user-visible behavior before and after this change.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and their results. Include screenshots only when useful and free of private data.

- [ ] I included no license keys, credentials, purchases or private project data.
